Metadata.title: Flashcards
Metadata.description: Create decks, review terms, and study faster with focused flashcards.

HomePage.headline: Flashcards that actually stick
HomePage.description: Create decks, drill terms, and review on any device - the simple way to study like you mean it.

smartReview.title: Smart review
smartReview.body: Focus on what you still need - not what you already know.

yourPace.title: Your pace
yourPace.body: Short sessions, clear progress, no clutter.

anyTopic.title: Any topic
anyTopic.body: Languages, exams, trivia - one place for all your sets.

ProductsPage.headline: Pick a deck and start learning
ProductsPage.description: These are placeholder cards - wire them to Convex when your decks table is ready.

AboutPage.headline: Learning tools, without the noise
AboutPage.description: We're building a focused flashcard experience: fast decks, clear progress, and fewer distractions - so you can spend energy on what you're actually learning.

whyFlashcards.title: Why flashcards?
whyFlashcards.body: Active recall beats passive re-reading. Short prompts and instant checks help your brain strengthen memories where it counts.

whatsNext.title: What's next
whatsNext.body: Decks tied to your account, spaced repetition, and sharing sets with classmates - stay tuned as we grow this app.
